apiKey.label: OpenAI API key
apiKey.saved: Key stored securely in the system.

hotkey.label: Dictation shortcut (hold to talk)
hotkey.help: Hold the shortcut to dictate; release it to transcribe.

outputMode.label: What to do with the text
outputMode.insert: Insert it where the cursor is
outputMode.clipboard: Just copy it to the clipboard

language.label: Application language
language.hint: The system tray menu switches language when the app restarts.

startup.label: Startup and residency
startup.autostart: Start VoiceText when the computer turns on
startup.startMinimized: Start minimized to the system tray

status.label: Status
status.idle: Ready to dictate — hold {{hotkey}}, speak, then release.
status.delivered: Text copied to the clipboard ({{chars}} characters) — paste it with Ctrl+V.

stt.auth: The API key is invalid or not configured.
stt.network: Could not connect to the transcription provider.
stt.rate: The provider's rate limit was reached.
stt.provider: The transcription provider returned an error.

audio.config: The microphone has an unsupported configuration.

hotkey.invalid: The shortcut you entered is not valid.
hotkey.register: Could not register the global shortcut.

delivery.blocked: Could not insert the text into the active application.
delivery.clipboard: Could not copy the text to the clipboard.
delivery.insert: Could not insert the text; it was copied to the clipboard so you can paste it with Ctrl+V.

keyring.unavailable: Could not access the system credential store.
